judged_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:26-42 — `prisma.booking.findFirst({ where: { id: bookingId } })` fetches any booking by id with no org/team/user scoping in the query itself, relying entirely on the later manual check (line 46-56) to enforce ownership; this is a latent IDOR risk pattern (defense only exists in application code, not the query), and if isTeamAdmin/isTeamOwner ever throw, return true unexpectedly for a non-existent team (booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0 defaults to a fake team id 0), or if that later check is ever refactored/removed, any authenticated user could add guests to (and trigger emails/calendar updates for) an arbitrary booking they don't own — confidence 50, severity P2 (defense-in-depth gap, not currently confirmed exploitable since isOrganizer/isAttendee checks appear correctly scoped to booking.userId/attendees).
